openings.claim: Unreliable identity-linked addresses may explain delays; check exception locations whenever books move, retaining shelves, dividers and cart.
openings.discriminator: Accurate addresses reducing second searches supports locator repair; persistent burst-window delays with little searching supports clerk congestion. Matched cart results test whether shelving helps.
openings.probe: Clerk compares matched pickups before/during locator updates; record arrival, service start, retrieval, completion, address accuracy, second searches and update work. Verify recipients; stop at preparation cap.
openings.uncertainty: Preservation applies to the capped probe. Reservation verification capability, sustained feasibility and improvement remain unconfirmed; cart speed may depend on volume and book size.

openings.claim: Convert verified household-surname misplacements into behind-desk pointers from reserving-reader surname to actual divider region; invalidate on movement. Pointers order searches, never authorize handoff.
openings.discriminator: Affected pickups improving while unrelated pickups do not supports mismatch causation. Ordinary re-shelving matching or outperforming pointers supports one-time sorting error; recurring household placement may favor pointers.
openings.probe: Compare affected pointer pickups with matched re-shelved pickups; track first-location success, ambiguity, staleness and combined preparation/update burden. Stop if recipient verification is unavailable.
openings.uncertainty: Mismatch causation, recurrence, unambiguous entitlement verification and affordable upkeep are unknown; stale/ambiguous pointers or excess preparation defeat feasibility.

lineage.reason: Preserves locator repair, congestion rival and cart counterexample.
Preserves alternate-address conversion and ordinary re-shelving comparison.

decision: Both probes require only the existing clerk, two shelves and return cart; names/contact details stay behind desk. Cap daily preparation including counted corrections at ten clerk-minutes and measure movement work. Target remains 95% of available pickups within two minutes, with no wrong-reader handoffs. All observations are synthetic; interview representativeness and both interventions' target attainment remain unknown.
